description: `header.payload.signature`, each part base64url encoded. The payload is readable by anyone: signed, not encrypted.
HMAC-SHA256 with a shared secret: the same key signs and verifies. RS256/ES256 use a private key to sign and a public key to verify.
Base64 with `-` and `_` instead of `+` and `/`, and no `=` padding, so the value is safe in URLs and headers.
`sub` (subject), `iat` (issued at), `exp` (expiry), `nbf`, `iss` (issuer), `aud` (audience); times are seconds since the epoch.
A forged token with `"alg": "none"` and no signature. Verifiers must pin the expected algorithm instead of trusting the header.
`decode` only reads the payload; `verify` checks the signature and claims. Authorization must use the result of `verify`.
